items.headline: The Bulletin announced — monthly scratch night at The Old Red Lion, Islington
items.body: Our new monthly work-in-progress night launches this year: music, cabaret, sketches and plays from the Here & Now ensemble, with a different guest host each month. Join the mailing list to hear the first date.

items.headline: V is for Victims: a new musical comedy, coming 2027
items.body: A murder mystery in the tradition of Agatha Christie, with the comic misdirection of Rian Johnson's Knives Out films — and a score of brand new original songs. Writing and songwriting are underway now.
